specification-gate.description: Acceptance criteria are written in Given/When/Then with the non-functional sections.

plan-gate.description: A change plan names the files, the tests and the risks.

implementation-gate.description: Implementation may start only with a plan and an active, clean change contract.

tdd-red-gate.description: A behavioral RED failure was observed for the current behavior.

tdd-green-gate.description: The targeted test passes after the minimum implementation.

tdd-refactor-gate.description: Refactoring kept the affected tests green.

defect-reproduction-gate.description: The defect is reproduced, or its reproduction is documented as impossible.

defect-fix-gate.description: The regression test exists and the defect no longer reproduces.

behavior-capture-gate.description: A behavioral baseline was captured before refactoring.

behavior-lock-gate.description: The public surface matches the baseline or changes are approved.

verification-gate.description: Evidence is current and the regression scope has run.

review-gate.description: Review findings, architecture and compatibility are resolved.

observability-gate.description: Health checks pass after the change.
